ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Ministry of Lands' Reference No.: 4-3/7/2019/hw/80. My Reference No.: 3/6/2019/2. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the Land to be acquired: The allotment of land depicted in the sheet No. 01 of Block No. 01 of Cadastral Map No. 421731 dated 11.12.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General, having the name and the extent as mentioned below, situated in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 893 of Parabewila, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Polgahawela, in Kurunegala District, in North Western Province, described as follows:

01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Ketakalagahamulawatta; Original Claimant: W. A. A. Gamini Senawirathne; Extent: 0.0053 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforementioned land/servitude on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Polgahawela, on the day of 16.04.2025 at 10.00 a.m. Moreover, it is hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 02.04.2025, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of computation of such amount. R. M. S. N. Rൺඃൺඉൺ඄ඌඁൾ, Divisional Secretary, Polgahawela. At Divisional Secretariat, Polgahawela, On 20th March, 2025. EOG 03 - 0231
